Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning public and private airport parking facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to public and private airport parking facilities;adding a new section to chapter 47.68 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that transparency inparking rates that support airport parking is critical for parkingconsumers to understand what the airport parking rates are and what thetotal parking charge will be, with all taxes and fees included, whenreturning to claim their vehicle.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.68 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A public or private airport parking facility's primaryadvertised rate must reflect the actual amount a consumer will pay whenclaiming his or her vehicle from the parking facility. The advertisedrate must clearly include all charges, fees, and taxes as its primaryrate, for daily, hourly, and monthly parking charges. When a vehicleis parked in a parking facility for any time over one day, one week, orone month, the parking facility must post whether the facility chargesthe overage by the hour or by the day along with the applicable rate. p. 1 HB 1483 (2) A public or private airport parking facility must post allrates and any discounts or coupons in effect at the entrance of theparking facility and must honor those applicable parking rates,discounts, or coupons when a vehicle is checked in for parking at thefacility. All parking discounts and coupons must be the same betweenall advertising media utilized by the parking facility. Any expirationdates on parking discounts or coupons being advertised must be in thesame size font as the largest font on the discount or coupon, printedmedia, or web site and must be in bold face type. (3) A public or private airport parking facility must use duediligence in ensuring that total transparency is achieved whencommunicating to a parking consumer what the total parking charge willbe when the person claims his or her vehicle from the parking facility.
